title: Sensor Relay
description: The &6Sensor Relay Satellite&r is used to produce &eOrbital Data&r. A single relay takes &e100 hours&r to produce one drive worth of orbital data. It can be sped up by installing more relays. Each additional Relay reduces the time linearly, meaning that a satellite with 100 relays will produce orbital data in just &eone hour&r.
